questions.question: Walk me through your experience preparing journal entries and reconciling general ledger accounts during month-end close.
In your bookkeeping role at Crippen & Co., how did you account for depreciable assets and prepare the related reports?
Describe your process for maintaining accurate payroll records, processing payroll, and ensuring payroll-related amounts were recorded correctly in the accounting records.
What methods have you used to reconcile bank statements, investigate discrepancies, and ensure cash accounts were balanced?
Give an example of how you analyzed financial statements or accounting records to identify an error, compliance issue, or reporting concern.
Describe your experience comparing budgeted costs to actual results and communicating the reasons for variances.
What experience do you have with accrual accounting, including identifying expenses that need to be accrued at period end?
This role requires SAP R/3 or S/4 FI experience. What accounting systems have you used, and how have you used them for general ledger, reporting, or reconciliations?
How have you ensured that accounting records and financial reports complied with applicable reporting standards, tax requirements, and internal procedures?

The role supports cost-center reporting and project profitability analysis. Describe an example of analyzing operating costs, revenues, or business performance to identify opportunities for improved profitability or cost reduction.
